chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “The time of Maghrib is when the disk disappears. If you then see it after that, while you had already prayed, you repeat the salat (prayer). Your sawm (fasting) is valid, but you must refrain from food if you had already taken some of it.”

key_terms.غَابَ الْقُرْصُ: the sun’s disk disappeared below the horizon
key_terms.مَضَى صَوْمُكَ: your sawm (fasting) remains valid and counts
key_terms.وَقْتُ الْمَغْرِبِ: the beginning time of the Maghrib prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be done if the sun is seen again after praying Maghrib and breaking the fast?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the time of Maghrib begins when the sun’s disk disappears. If a person prays and then sees the sun again, the salat (prayer) must be repeated, while the sawm (fasting) remains valid, though eating must stop immediately.
